description:
Her full name is Yukiko Amagi.
She's a member of the Investigation Team formed by a group of students from Yasogami High School, as well as a Persona user.
As daughter to the manager of the renowned Amagi Inn, she is undergoing training as its next heir.
Though quick-witted, she struggles a bit at reading the room and can come across as airheaded.

lines.text: I still can't believe it... This isn't inside the TV, it's... another world, isn't it?
I'm doing pretty well thanks to everyone being so kind. Thank you for looking out for me.
Oh...! Er, uh... Don't worry about me. I'm just a little nervous being in an unfamiliar place.
I'm totally used to this place now. It's all thanks to you.
I'm going to be practicing cooking with Emma. Would you like to come along?
Pfft... Oh, sorry. I was thinking of something Neon said earlier. It was just something silly... Hahaha.
